items.title: Alleged $165M crypto Ponzi mastermind faces US charges after Fiji deportation
items.snippet: Prosecutors allege Edward Zimbardi collected crypto from thousands of investors, lost over $34 million on currency trades and spent at least $10 million personally.

items.title: ‘Fabricated rumors’ about BitMart founder, Binance bStocks dominate: Asia Express
items.snippet: Binance’s bStocks are the second largest tokenized stock issuer just two months after launch, and BitMart’s internal feud erupts into the spotlight ahead of its closure
